Subject: Helium Summit — Post-event lead dump & quick ROI snapshot

Hi Mina / Monica,

Thanks again for partnering with Helium Labs on the Summit last week — really appreciated Redwood’s demo booth and the runtime talk, traffic was steady. Attached are the raw lead exports (helium_summit_leads.csv) and a quick ROI calc I ran the night after (ROI_calc_v1.xlsx).

High level:
- Total booth leads: 482 (includes scans + badge drops)
- Leads we flagged as MQL-ish: 73
- Demo signups (booked demos with Redwood reps): 18
- Post-event organic trials: ~12 in the first 72 hrs (Helium tracking)

A couple notes on attribution: our on-site badge scanner tags include "source" values (booth, session, partner-table) and we attach UTM when possible, but some manual inputs (handwritten cards) are classed as "unknown". I flagged 41 leads as "partner-introduced" (these were introduced by the Helium partnerships team directly to Monica).

Let me know what additional slices you want — we can re-run the export with timestamped touchpoints or include the pre-event nurture clicks.

Attachments: helium_summit_leads.csv (CSV stub), ROI_calc_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Best,
Sophie
Event Director, Helium Labs
(sophie@heliumlabs.com)

Subject: Re: Helium Summit — Post-event lead dump & quick ROI snapshot

Thanks Sophie — helpful summary. A couple quick clarifying asks before I pass this to finance and the growth committee: 

1) Can you break the "unknown" bucket by whether it was a scanned card vs handwritten?
2) For the 18 demo signups, do we have timestamps (time/date) and which rep the demo was assigned to? We need that to tie demos to our inbound demo funnel in HubSpot (HS-12345).
3) On the 41 "partner-introduced" leads: can you confirm whether those were logged in Helium's CRM and if they have email opt-in recorded?

Also Monica — Sophie flagged 41 partner-introduced leads which we counted differently on the field report (we had 27). That discrepancy is what's driving the sponsor credit request. Can you pull our onsite notes and the demo roster and stitch together a quick mutual action plan so we can present a clean ask to finance?

Appreciate it — I want to keep this tight so we can close the credit request this pay period.

—Mina
Senior Dir, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Lang <sophie@heliumlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Helium Summit — Post-event lead dump & quick ROI snapshot

Hi Mina / Markus / Monica,

Quick follow-up — thanks for the questions. Short answers:
- "Unknown" split: 29 scanned badges with illegible fields (we exported as scanned_raw), 12 handwritten cards we transcribed manually (marked handwritten_transcribed). I'll add those columns and resend a cleaned CSV.
- Demo timestamps: attached are the demo_bookings export (included inside helium_summit_leads.csv as a second sheet in our original system) — demos between 2026-09-09 10:10 PDT and 2026-09-10 16:05 PDT, assigned reps: Omar (Helium) for 4, Redwood-rep assigned for 14 (we included the rep email where present).
- Partner-introduced: all 41 were logged in our CRM; opt-in is marked for 33, missing for 8 (these were handwritten, we don't have explicit opt-in capture).

Attaching: signed-mop.pdf (signed MOP acknowledging sponsor deliverables) and updated notes in the Drive link.

If you want, we can run a timestamp join to HubSpot event webhook to micro-match demo times — will take ~48 hours.

Best,
Sophie
Event Director, Helium Labs

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Helium Summit — Post-event lead dump & quick ROI snapshot

Markus / Mina — forwarding Sophie’s clarification. I pulled our onsite notes and the demo roster; here's the internal summary and my recommendation for sponsor credit: 

Summary of discrepancy:
- Helium: 41 partner-introduced leads (33 opt-in, 8 no-opt)
- Redwood field report: 27 partner-introduced (we only counted leads handed directly to Redwood reps)
- 12 handwritten cards likely belong to Helium's team distribution and were double-counted in Helium's partner bucket.

Recommendation:
- Grant sponsor credit equal to the delta of mutually verified MQLs (Helium's opt-in partner leads that map to our demo or MQL criteria). Based on initial mapping that is 19 leads -> sponsor credit request of $12,000 (per MOP: $625 per verified MQL).
- Put a conditional clause: credit payment contingent on Helium providing timestamped joins for 8 contested leads within 72 hours. If they fail, reduce credit to $8,000.

I attached an updated ROI calc (ROI_calc_v2.xlsx) with the mapping I ran (column notes included). I'm comfortable presenting this to finance today if Markus gives the green light.

Attachments: ROI_calc_v2.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Thanks,
Monica
Sr. Manager, Field Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sophie Lang <sophie@heliumlabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helium Summit — KPI rollforward & sponsor credit request

Thanks all for the quick work. I reviewed Monica's ROI_calc_v2 and Sophie’s exports. Decision and next steps: 

Decision:
- Approve a partial sponsor credit of $8,000 now (reflects 13 fully verified partner-introduced MQLs that map cleanly to our demo signups and HubSpot records).
- The remaining disputed amount ($4,000) is contingent on Helium providing the 8 timestamped joins / CRM records within 72 hours. If provided and mapped, we will issue the remaining $4,000.

Operational asks: 
- Sophie: please upload the timestamp join files to the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HeliumSummit/PostEvent) and cc this thread.
- Monica: please prepare a one-pager for finance showing the mapping (include HubSpot activity IDs and demo booking timestamps) — I need that before I cut the credit.

Sophie, appreciate the signed MOP; we’ll have finance route the $8k credit to Helium's partner invoice this month. Expect the credit to appear on the Oct 2026 invoice.

I’m looping finance after I get Monica’s one-pager; copying Sophie so this remains transparent.

—Markus
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
